decision_update.instruction: Do not add xyz:SKHX because xyz:MU and xyz:SKHX represent the same semiconductor industry exposure.
decision_update.interpretation: Exclude SKHX from the planned live roster and candidate-promotion queue. Continue evaluating MU as the sole semiconductor research candidate without granting it live authority.
decision_update.observer_impact: The SKHX observer is not running and will not be restarted for promotion work under this decision.

hypothesis.claim: Use at most one semiconductor candidate so the remaining non-crypto slot can add a distinct economic exposure rather than duplicate semiconductor concentration.
hypothesis.falsifier_or_update: Only an explicit user reversal can return SKHX to the candidate queue. MU still requires its predeclared forward-evidence threshold before any approval-ready live proposal.

mu_status.next_evidence_trigger: Reassess at 20 independent paths or the first short-side onset, whichever occurs first.

portfolio_reasoning.benefit: Reserves the final non-crypto slot for a different industry or return mechanism and avoids intentional duplication of semiconductor exposure.
portfolio_reasoning.risk: Excluding SKHX could forgo an asset-specific edge that later evidence might reveal, but no such qualified edge is currently established.
portfolio_reasoning.validation: The current v51 live config contains neither MU nor SKHX. Process inspection found the MU report-only observer running and no SKHX observer process.
portfolio_reasoning.good_enough: SKHX remains absent from live and candidate-promotion configurations; MU remains observation-only until its declared evidence threshold is met.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve the current SPCX lifecycle and capture the first attributable SP500 long under v51 while MU continues report-only toward 20 independent paths or its first short onset.
limitations: This is a portfolio-composition decision, not evidence that MU is profitable or that SKHX cannot be profitable.
No live strategy, asset, route, sizing, leverage, stop, exit, execution, process, or deployment setting changed.
MU has only long-side eligible forward onsets so far; bidirectional robustness is unmeasured.
The fourth non-crypto slot remains unfilled until a distinct mechanism produces qualified evidence.
